Imagine you find a tiny bottle on your desk.
There is one word on it.
Invisible.
You drink it.
And suddenly, nobody can see you.
Your clothes float in the air.
You are gone.
At first, it is amazing.
Your mom walks right past you.
You go to school without being seen.
The teacher never checks your homework.
You walk up to the board and change your own grade.
A plus.
Nobody sees a thing.
But at lunch, your best friend sits alone.
You talk to her.
She just stares at an empty chair.
The next day, she is gone.
No messages.
Nobody is looking for you.
You scream for help.
Your mom walks right past the door.
But here is the twist.
To see anything, light must hit your eyes.
If the light passes straight through you,
it never reaches your eyes either.
Invisible.
And blind.
Follow for part two.
